He says Cardi B must settle him. He has decided to keep fighting his div0rce case with Cardi B and has now taken the matter to the Supreme Court after their separation was officially completed by a lower court. Reports say the court ruled that he would not get any part of Cardi B’s estimated $130 million fortune. However, he is not happy with that decision and is now asking for more than $50 million, saying the judgment was not fair. According to him, if the situation was the other way around, the court might have ordered that the money be shared between both sides.
